acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/retailer/buildRetailerPassport.ts exporting: buildRetailerPassport(data: BatteryPassportData): RetailerPassportView

categories has exactly 5 entries: (1) id='carbon' title='Carbon Footprint' grade from carbonFootprintPerformanceClassValue; (2) id='recycled' title='Recycled Content' grade='D' if both recycled percentages are 0, else 'B'; (3) id='performance' title='Capacity & Performance' grade='A' if grossCapacityKwh >= 0.6; (4) id='compliance' title='Compliance & Conformity' grade='A' if declarationOfConformityRef is set else 'C'; (5) id='origin' title='Manufacturing Origin' grade='A' if placeOfManufacture includes 'Germany' or 'Bavaria' else 'C'. userStories.title: Generic ERP adapter interface and Odoo XML-RPC implementation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a typed adapter pattern so new ERP systems can be added without changing sync logic. The Odoo adapter uses XML-RPC over fetch with no new npm dependencies.
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/lib/erp/types.ts exporting: ErpPayload { orderNumber: string; batchNumber: string; passportReferenceId: string; passportUrl: string }, ErpSyncResult { success: boolean; externalId?: string | number; error?: string; skipped?: boolean }, ErpAdapterConfig { type: string; baseUrl: string; database?: string | null; username?: string | null; apiKey: string; targetModel: string }
Export abstract interface ErpAdapter { sync(payload: ErpPayload): Promise<ErpSyncResult> } in src/lib/erp/types.ts

Create src/lib/erp/odoo-adapter.ts exporting class OdooAdapter implements ErpAdapter. Constructor takes ErpAdapterConfig. Implements two private methods: authenticate() which POSTs to {baseUrl}/xmlrpc/2/common with XML-RPC methodCall authenticate(db, username, password, {}) and parses the returned integer uid from the XML response using string parsing (no xml parser dep); sync(payload) which calls authenticate then POSTs to {baseUrl}/xmlrpc/2/object with XML-RPC execute_kw(db, uid, apiKey, targetModel, 'create', [{ name: payload.passportReferenceId, note: JSON.stringify(payload) }], {}) and returns { success: true, externalId: parsedId }. On any fetch error or non-200, return { success: false, error: message }.

XML-RPC request body must be built with a pure string template (no external xml lib). Helper buildXmlRpcCall(method, params): string where params is an array of JS primitives serialized to <value><string>|<int>|<boolean>|<struct>|<array> nodes.

Create src/lib/erp/adapter-factory.ts exporting getAdapter(config: ErpAdapterConfig): ErpAdapter that returns new OdooAdapter(config) for type 'ODOO' and throws Error('Unsupported ERP type') otherwise.

Create src/tests/odoo-adapter.test.ts with @vitest-environment node, mock global fetch using vi.stubGlobal, test: (1) authenticate returns uid from mocked XML response; (2) sync calls execute_kw and returns externalId on success; (3) sync returns { success: false, error } when fetch throws

npm test passes

Query prisma.batch.findUnique({ where: { id: batchId }, include: { order: { include: { manufacturer: { include: { erpIntegration: true } } } }, passport: true } })
If batch not found return { success: false, error: 'Batch not found' }

Build ErpAdapterConfig from erpIntegration fields
Build ErpPayload: { orderNumber: batch.order.orderNumber, batchNumber: batch.batchNumber, passportReferenceId: batch.passport?.passportId ?? batchId, passportUrl: batch.passport?.passportUrl ?? '' }
Call getAdapter(config).sync(payload)
On success: prisma.batch.update({ where: { id: batchId }, data: { status: 'ERP_SYNCED', erpSyncedAt: new Date(), erpPayloadJson: JSON.stringify(payload) } })
Return the ErpSyncResult from the adapter

Test (2): when ERP_SYNC_ENABLED='true' but erpIntegration.enabled=false, returns { success: false, skipped: true }. Use vi.mock for prisma and adapter-factory.
